answer: Admission to the meadow runs on silicon seeds: every knoll must present a seed burned into a unique host die at manufacture, and the meadow rejects any seed already seen. Clouds fail because their images share one seed. Seeds are auctioned, so the kth knoll pays the kth lowest bid in signal; as clones drain the supply of dies, bids rise, and one die cannot fund two knolls. The bill for n clones is about n²/2 signal, unbatchable since seeds cannot be copied. It breaks if a fab sells cloned seeds.
